items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: I brought men like... Bobby Haggart of course of fame... And it was their organization. Nobody talked. If you talked to any of the guys they’ll say, “I didn’t talk, I just looked.”... Haggart, when Haggart said, “I’ve got to get out of here”

ctx.x: —how the philosophy changes. Now it’s the elite job in New York. But at that time, they really didn’t want a staff job either. It was strange. They didn’t know where to go or what to do. So I brought men like, well I could start with Doc Carl Severinsen. I took him from Charlie Barnet’s band, and Clark Terry from the Ellington band, Tommy Newsom was with the Navy band in Washington, Hymie Schertzer had been with the Goodman band, I mean I could go through the whole, Bobby Haggart of course of fame, the best bass…
I’ll tell him that. You actually referred to him as the Chairman of the Board of the Time Factory.
